entities.name: Erika Jurinová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erika Jurinová is a Slovak teacher and politician. In 2010–2018, she was a member of the National Council. Since 2017, she has served as the governor of the Žilina Region. She is the first, and as of 2022 only, female regional governor in Slovakia.
